indicators.flag: A customer or a customer’s counterparty conducts transactions with OFAC-designated entities and individuals, or transactions that contain a nexus to identifiers listed for OFAC-designated entities and individuals, to include, email addresses, physical addresses, phone numbers, or passport numbers, or virtual currency addresses.
indicators.red_flag: Counterparty match to OFAC-designated entity or its identifiers (email / address / phone / passport / VC wallet nexus)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.flag: Information included in a transaction between customers indicates support for terrorist campaigns.
indicators.red_flag: Transaction memo / narrative signals terrorist-campaign support
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: A customer conducts transactions with a Money Services Business (MSB) or other financial institution, including one that offers services in virtual currency, operates in higher-risk jurisdictions tied to Hamas activity, and is reasonably believed or suspected to have lax customer due diligence (CDD) requirements, opaque ownership, or otherwise fails to comply with anti-money laundering/combatting the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) best practices.
indicators.red_flag: Flow to weak-AML MSB / VASP in Hamas-linked high-risk jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: A customer conducts transactions that originate with, are directed to, or otherwise involve entities that are shell corporations, general “trading companies,” or other companies that have a nexus with Iran or other Iran-supported terrorist groups, such as Hizballah and Palestine Islamic Jihad.
indicators.red_flag: Shell / generic "trading company" counterparty with Iran-proxy nexus
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: A customer that is a charitable organization or nonprofit organization (NPO)9 solicits donations but does not appear to provide any charitable services or openly supports Hamas’s terrorist activity or operations.  In some cases, these organizations may post on social media platforms or encrypted messaging apps to solicit donations, including in virtual currency.
indicators.red_flag: NPO donation-solicitation with no charitable output / pro-Hamas web presence
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: A customer that is a charitable organization or NPO receives large donations from an unknown source over a short period of time and then sends significant wire transfers or checks to other charitable organizations or NPOs.
indicators.red_flag: NPO rapid donation-in → wire / check pass-through to other NPOs (charity-layering)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: A customer conducts transactions with known or suspected virtual currency addresses tied to terrorism or terrorist financing donation campaigns.
indicators.red_flag: VC transfer to wallet flagged in terror-financing donation campaign
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.
